why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Open the Bytes page Go to the Bytes page of the Curvance app. It has Overview, Ranks, Leaderboard and Referral tabs.
2 Step 2 : Connect a wallet Press Connect wallet on the page. The page asks for this before it shows your referral code and lets you start earning Bytes. Until then, Your Bytes reads 0.
3 Step 3 : Check what earns Bytes The Bytes page does not list which actions earn Bytes. The Curvance docs describe the product the page belongs to.
4 Step 4 : Open Ranks and Leaderboard The Bytes page has Ranks and Leaderboard tabs, and it invites visitors to connect a wallet to track their ranking and rewards.
